name: Canva
description: Canva is a template-based design tool for social posts, presentations, resumes and simple logos, made for people who are not designers.
features: Templates for social posts, presentations and documents
limitations: Popular templates look familiar, so customise colours and text
Check commercial-use terms for specific content before client work
Prices differ by country; the amounts we recorded are in Pakistani rupees and per year only

free.details: Canva Free includes the drag-and-drop editor, 1.6M+ templates, 5GB of cloud storage and limited access to Standard and Premium AI.

pricing.trial: Canva Pro and Canva Business show a free trial option on the pricing page.

plans.name: Pro
plans.billing: Shown as Rs 9,200 per year for one person
plans.note: Yearly view, shown in PKR for a Pakistan visitor: Rs 9,200 per year for one person. Monthly and USD prices not captured.

plans.name: Business
plans.billing: Shown as Rs 16,000 per year per person
plans.note: Yearly view, shown in PKR for a Pakistan visitor: Rs 16,000 per year per person. Monthly and USD prices not captured.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Contact sales; 1TB storage, SSO and SCIM, dedicated success manager for 150+ contracted seats

pricing.regional: Canva showed these prices in rupees (Rs), per year, for the region this page was opened from (Pakistan). Other countries see different currencies and prices, and USD and monthly prices were not captured. Do not treat the rupee amounts as a universal price.
notes: AI Pass is an extra-cost add-on for Pro and Business.
K-12 educational organisations and not-for-profits can get most premium features free (pricing page FAQ).
